source.title: Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Hillsborough Rural District")
source.publisher: Lisburn Standard (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: deemed re-elected: no candidate in columns 2-6 and the retiring councillor named in column 7 ('Names of Retiring Councillors deemed to be Re-elected') of the Returning Officer's notice of result (Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1; read on the BNA page image)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Only Carryduff was contested; two new members were returned unopposed. The other thirteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's notice of result (Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1), which also confirms the Carryduff poll (Booth 352, Carlisle 250) and the Anahilt and Edenderry returns; Drumbo's retiring member was deemed re-elected (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
